title: 听力挑战 · 谈论爱好

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?
rounds.lineCn: 空闲时间你喜欢做什么?

grammar.name: 动名词作宾语
grammar.note: enjoy doing 中 doing 是动名词,表示喜欢做的动作。

options.text: I enjoy playing basketball with friends.
options.feedback: enjoy doing 动名词作宾语,回答爱好贴切。

options.text: I enjoy my dinner every night.
options.feedback: enjoy 接名词表示享受晚饭,没有回答爱好。
过去时说的是昨天一次动作,不是爱好。

rounds.speaker: 同学
rounds.line: How long have you been into photography lately?
rounds.lineCn: 你最近迷上摄影多久了?

grammar.name: 动名词作介词宾语
grammar.note: be into 后接动名词或名词,表示对某事物的兴趣。

options.text: I love taking photos of birds.
options.feedback: love doing 用动名词说明摄影爱好,回应自然。
说的是上周的偶尔活动,不是持续爱好。

options.text: I am good at math and science.
options.feedback: 谈的是学科,没有回应摄影话题。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: What do you think about going hiking this weekend?

grammar.name: 动名词作介词宾语
grammar.note: about 后接动名词 going,介词后动词必须用 -ing 形式。

options.text: That sounds great. I like hiking a lot.
options.feedback: like doing 表达对徒步的喜爱,接受提议自然。
过去时谈上个月的事,没有回应这周末的提议。

options.text: I like to eat pizza on weekends.
options.feedback: 谈的是吃披萨,与徒步提议无关。
